answer: A fresh key reaches the inlet with nothing behind it, no history to spend. In PoA, weight comes only from quorum-matched grading verdicts a key has sealed on-ledger, each one re-checked against consensus, so standing cannot be minted or handed over. It climbs slowly, like a vine working its way up a knoll, one honest epoch at a time. A thousand clones must each repay that whole climb themselves; the sybil bill grows linearly in the number of identities, and no warmed credential transfers.
